This affects an unknown function of the component Provisioning Callback/Activity Stream. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. No exploit is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-77601 | OpenC3 COSMOS up to 7.2.x Plugin Installation plugin_model.rb PluginModel.install_phase2 pypi_url os command injection
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability marked as critical has been reported in OpenC3 COSMOS up to 7.2.x. The impacted element is the function OpenC3::PluginModel.install_phase2 of the file openc3/lib/openc3/models/plugin_model.rb of the component Plugin Installation. Performing a manipulation of the argument pypi_url results in os command injection. This vulnerability is cataloged as CVE-2026-77601. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. There is no exploit available. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.
